title: Brown representability for cohomological functors
statement: Let C be a compactly generated triangulated category [def-weil-triangulated-category] with set-indexed coproducts. Every contravariant cohomological functor H:C^{op}\to Ab [def-sp-abelian] that sends set-indexed coproducts in C to products of abelian groups is representable: there exist an object G of C and natural isomorphisms H(c)\cong Hom_C(c,G).

mathlib_searches.query: Every cohomological functor from a compactly generated triangulated category to abelian groups that sends coproducts to products is representable

mathlib_searches.results: no Brown representability theorem; only homological functor and Yoneda declarations
